#Lib
```{r}
library(bigrquery)

```

#Obter 2022 a 2023
```{r}
sql_query <- '
SELECT  data,
        status_infracao,
        valor_pago,
        especie_veiculo,
        data_pagamento,
        data_limite_recurso,
        data_pagamento,
        descricao_situacao_autuacao,
        tipo_veiculo 
FROM `rj-smtr.transito.autuacao` 
WHERE data >= "2022-01-01" AND data < "2023-01-01" 
ORDER BY data ASC
LIMIT 10'
```

#Executar
```{r}
results <- bq_project_query(project_id, sql_query) 
df_autuacao <- bq_table_download(results)
```
